title: •Bib Fortuna
caption: •Bib Fortuna (V)
game_text: Opponent’s non-Jedi characters are deploy +1 to {set:jabbaspalace} sites. Once during your control phase, you may place three cards from hand in Used Pile to reveal top card of Reserve Deck; if it is an alien, take it into hand.
lore: Twi’lek leader and majordomo of Jabba’s palace. Succeeded Jabba’s last majordomo, Naroon Cuthus. Plotting to kill Jabba.

heading: •Bib Fortuna ({set:jabbaspalace} persona only) (V)
notes: Sheet group: Everything else. Unique. Slip heading '•Bib Fortuna ([gold eye sphere] persona only) (V)' — the sphere is the Jabba's Palace expansion symbol (matches set-jabbaspalace-grainy.png) → heading with {set:jabbaspalace}; bottom strip prints '•Bib Fortuna (V)'. The same Jabba's Palace symbol is printed inline in 'deploy +1 to [JP] sites' → {set:jabbaspalace}; the STUB DROPS IT ('deploy +1 to sites'). Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 1, third box empty; deploy 3 / forfeit 4 (as printed). Icon column empty (printed card has none either). Alien. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Steven Lewis' / 'Yavin 4 Regionals 2006' → credit_bottom. LORE corrected: curly apostrophes Twi’lek, Jabba’s ×2 (wiki straight). 'leader' plain on the 350 px printed scan; the PC's V25 remake prints it bold — left plain. Copyright JP 1998 line legible enough. Modern: V25-D-bibfortuna.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 25 Bib Fortuna (V), same printed lore/art); VB3-D-bibfortuna-pre (350, probably this slip reissued) also exists, not downloaded.
